levelAscensionChart.unlocks: Attribute 12 and Skill 5 maximums unlock; multiple Attributes at 11 and Skills at 4 are now allowed.
You may choose a third Combat Skill Focus.

experiencePoints.description: The characters spent little to no time pursuing the party's Common Cause, and no Values were used or challenged.
The characters spent some time pursuing the party's Common Cause, and one or two characters used or challenged their Values.

Most of the session is spent pursuing the party's Common Cause, and at least half of the characters have used or challenged their Values. The story has been changed because of the actions taken and decisions made by characters.

Most of the session is spent pursuing the party's Common Cause, and almost if not all of the party has used or challenged their Values. The characters have succeeded (or failed) in achieving their goals, and the story has been changed significantly.

respecOptions: Decrease one Attribute by 1 (to a minimum of 6) and increase another by 1 (to the level-appropriate maximum).
Decrease one Skill by 1 (to a minimum of 1) and increase another by 1 (to the level-appropriate maximum).
Replace a Combat Talent that is not a prerequisite for anything else you have with any other Combat Talent you meet the prerequisites for.
Replace a Narrative Talent with any other Narrative Talent you meet the prerequisites for.
Reassign which Skills your Combat Focuses are in.
